# Alaska Airlines Careers

> > Alaska Airlines Careers is the primary recruitment portal for Alaska Air Group's three airlines, featuring pilot, flight attendant, technician, and corporate positions with comprehensive benefits and development programs.

This careers portal serves Alaska Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines, and Horizon Air, offering job opportunities across aviation operations, technology, corporate functions, and support roles. The site emphasizes employee benefits, career development, diversity initiatives, and company culture across multiple locations including Seattle headquarters and airport hubs.

## Key Topics

- Alaska Airlines
- Hawaiian Airlines
- Horizon Air
- Alaska Air Group
- Pilot jobs

## Career Opportunities

- [Pilot Jobs](https://careers.alaskaair.com/career-opportunities/pilot-jobs): Pilot job opportunities & training at Alaska Air Group airlines
- [Flight Attendants](https://careers.alaskaair.com/career-opportunities/flight-attendants): Flight attendant positions & Pathways Program at Alaska Airlines
- [Aircraft Technician Jobs](https://careers.alaskaair.com/career-opportunities/aircraft-technician-jobs): Aircraft maintenance & technician development program opportunities
- [Airport Operations Jobs](https://careers.alaskaair.com/career-opportunities/airport-operations): Airport operations roles: ramp agents, cargo & ground service positions
- [Software & Technology Jobs](https://careers.alaskaair.com/career-opportunities/information-and-technology-services): Software engineering & IT career opportunities in Seattle tech jobs
- [Corporate and Operations Jobs](https://careers.alaskaair.com/career-opportunities/corporate-office): Corporate & operations roles at Seattle headquarters & Sea-Tac
- [Contact Centers Jobs](https://careers.alaskaair.com/career-opportunities/contact-centers): Remote & hybrid contact center jobs in SeaTac & Chandler locations
- [Internship Program](https://careers.alaskaair.com/career-opportunities/interns): Paid 12-week internship program for college students across airlines

## Compensation & Benefits

- [Employee Benefits Overview](https://careers.alaskaair.com/benefits): Employee benefits overview including travel perks, wellness & stock plans

## Company Culture & People

- [Our People](https://careers.alaskaair.com/our-people): Company culture, diversity, sustainability & employee values overview
- [Career Development](https://careers.alaskaair.com/our-people/development): Career development & Developing Emerging Leaders program for growth
- [Veterans Programs](https://careers.alaskaair.com/our-people/veterans): Veterans recruitment & military employee resource group support
- [Community Involvement](https://careers.alaskaair.com/our-people/communities): Community involvement, volunteer programs & corporate social responsibility

## Main Portal

- [Home](https://careers.alaskaair.com): Main careers portal for Alaska Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines & Horizon Air
